name: Resend Node.js SDK
solves: Provides a TypeScript-first Node.js SDK for the Resend email API, enabling transactional and marketing email sending with support for React email templates, batch sending, webhooks, contacts/audiences management, and automation workflows.
best_for: Transactional email in Next.js or React-based apps using JSX email templates
Startups and indie projects wanting a modern developer-friendly email API with minimal setup
Batch email sending with built-in contact and audience management
Applications that need webhook-based email event tracking (delivery, bounces, opens)
Teams wanting a fully typed TypeScript email SDK with first-class React email support
skip_when: You need a self-hosted or open-source email sending infrastructure with no vendor lock-in
You require SMTP relay or direct SMTP integration rather than an HTTP API
Your project needs to stay within a completely free tier — Resend's free plan has sending limits
You want a multi-provider email abstraction layer that can switch between SendGrid, SES, etc.
You are working in a non-Node.js backend — use Resend's Python, Go, Ruby, or Java SDKs instead
